defaults.source: Distilled from [gotenberg.dev](https://gotenberg.dev) — routes, configuration and every module — retrieved 2026-08-20.

convert.title: Gotenberg conversion routes
convert.description: Gotenberg conversion: HTML, URL and Markdown to PDF via Chromium, Office documents via LibreOffice, screenshots, the full route list. Use when converting a document or page to PDF with Gotenberg.
convert.intro: Two engines: Chromium renders web content, LibreOffice handles Office formats. The route decides which.

pdf.title: Gotenberg PDF manipulation
pdf.description: Gotenberg PDF manipulation: merge, split, PDF/A and PDF/UA, flatten, encrypt, metadata, bookmarks, Factur-X, stamp, watermark. Use when manipulating an existing PDF with Gotenberg.
pdf.intro: Operations on a PDF you already have. All live under the PDF engines route and compose in one request.

operations.title: Gotenberg operations
operations.description: Gotenberg operations: Docker and Kubernetes installation, all CLI flags and env vars, webhooks, URL filtering, metrics, troubleshooting, clients. Use when deploying or configuring Gotenberg.
operations.intro: Running and calling Gotenberg. It is stateless, so configuration is entirely flags and environment.
